_venmo: The URL from the Venmo app's own QR (Me tab > QR), or a profile handle without the @; venmo_handle is the display handle on the agreement. images/venmo-qr.svg keys off it (run tools/build-qr.ps1 after changing it); the agreement's two pay links carry the same URL by hand.
_note: Public origin, e.g. https://devonkubacki.com (no trailing slash). Leave empty until the domain exists: og:image, canonical, sitemap.xml and the robots.txt Sitemap line are skipped without it.
